entities.summary: Anton Mykolaiovych But is a Ukrainian-Russian former professional ice hockey winger who currently played over 300 games in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by the New Jersey Devils in the 5th round of the 1998 NHL Entry Draft.
